biggest_catch: You only get paid after the friend completes a two-part gauntlet - a direct deposit/autopay/recurring debit transaction AND eight debit card purchases within 60 days - and the reward is a Visa Reward Card (not cash) that takes 4-6 weeks to arrive.
catches: Referrer must register for the ReferLive program; Arvest associates are ineligible.

Friend must register via the referrer's link, open a new qualified Arvest checking account within 180 days of referral registration, and within 60 days of account opening: (a) have a direct deposit OR automatic payment OR recurring debit card transaction, AND (b) make eight debit card purchases.

Strict transaction definitions: Arvest-to-Arvest transfers, ATM deposits/withdrawals, and returned items do not qualify; merchants may process recurring debit transactions as one-time and break qualification.
Cap: five (5) Reward Cards ($250 value) per calendar year; only the first referrer of a person is paid.
Reward is a $50 Visa Reward Card, delivered 4-6 weeks after requirements are met; rewards may be reported as income to the IRS.
Program may be discontinued or changed at any time without notice.

steps: Register for the Arvest ReferLive program.
Share your referral link with friends and family by email or social media.
Friend registers via your link and opens a new qualified Arvest checking account within 180 days.
Within 60 days of opening, friend sets up a direct deposit/autopay/recurring debit transaction AND makes eight debit card purchases.
You receive a $50 Visa Reward Card 4-6 weeks later (up to 5 per year).
